messages:
devon: Hey team — kicking off CloudAccelerator partner enablement for our "cloud-accelerator" terraform playbook. Goal: lightweight refarch + one-click module for marketplace listing. Need owners for module, QA, and README/architecture diagram. timeline: ~3 weeks. @maria do you have capacity?

maria: I can own module structure + README. Will lean on eng-infra for CI. timeline works for me. quick q: do we want the module in a monorepo or a dedicated repo for the partner?

ash: separate repo recommended for partner branding and CLA reasons. also cleaner for marketplace packaging and release cadence. smoke tests ci should be in the repo too.

kira: I can build the sample app and e2e smoke tests. leaning GH Actions + terratest. do we need multi-arch (arm/amd) builds for the containers?

devon: yes — target both arm64 and amd64. include prebuilt container images in our registry and small AMI images for reference. CI should run a qemu-emulated job for the arm matrix. keep example minimal in repo root so partners can launch quickly.

maria: proposed module API to start (we can iterate):
```
module "cloud_accel" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/cloud-accel-terraform//modules/serve"
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  replicas = var.replicas
  enable_kms = var.enable_kms
}
```
Outputs: lb_dns, autoscale_group_id, role_arn. Also include example var file and minimal README with diagram link.

ash: add tagging standard to the README: tags = { team = "inference", partner = "cloud-accelerator", env = var.env, sku = var.sku }. include IAM least-privilege snippet and a note about private deployment (VPC endpoints + SG examples).

partner_onboard_bot: New onboarding checklist created: https://rwd.company/onboard/CA-001 :white_check_mark:

kira: one question on marketplace packaging — do we publish just the terraform module to Terraform Registry or also package native cloud templates (CloudFormation/ARM/ARM64 container manifests)? my vote: both. module for infra-as-code users, native templates for marketplace one-click.

devon: agree on both. action items & owners: 
- maria: create repo + module scaffold, publish initial README and diagram link (due 2024-03-08)
- kira: sample app + terratest smoke suite (due 2024-03-10)
- ash: CI + packaging pipeline (GH Actions -> registry publish, due 2024-03-12)
I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue 10am PT to review progress. :calendar:

maria: noted, starting scaffold today. will include example var files and a simple network diagram SVG. ping me if you want specific naming conventions.

ash: I'll draft CI snippet and push to a draft branch. example GH Actions matrix to start: 
```
strategy:
  matrix:
    arch: [amd64, arm64]
    terraform_version: ["1.4.0"]
```

kira: adding terratest checks for module outputs + a minimal prompt set to validate inference endpoints once we have a deploy. will post green runs in #partnerships.

devon: thanks all — I'll add partner PM and solutions eng to the repo and open a PR for the kickoff doc. trying to keep this low-friction so partner can sign the CLA and try the quickstart in <30 minutes. :rocket:
